en.headline: Unemployment rate falls to 3.8 percent in August-October period
en.dek: The seasonally adjusted jobless rate edged down 0.1 points while underemployment held at 2 percent, with total employment at 3.65 million.
body: The Census and Statistics Department said the seasonally adjusted unemployment rate for August to October stood at 3.8 per cent, down 0.1 percentage points from the July-to-September period.
The underemployment rate remained unchanged at 2.0 per cent. Total employment fell by about 1,200 to 3,653,800, while the labour force declined by about 5,800 to 3,804,200.

Secretary for Labour and Welfare Chris Sun said the labour market had remained broadly stable. He noted that continued economic expansion, steady consumption and further growth in visitor arrivals should support overall employment, while the government would monitor external uncertainties and assist jobseekers.

zh.headline: 8至10月失業率回落至3.8%
zh.dek: 經季節性調整失業率微跌0.1個百分點，就業不足率維持2%，總就業人數約365萬。
body: 政府統計處公布，2026年8月至10月經季節性調整的失業率為3.8%，較7月至9月回落0.1個百分點。
就業不足率維持在2.0%不變。總就業人數減少約1,200人至3,653,800人，總勞動人口減少約5,800人至3,804,200人。
勞工及福利局局長孫玉菡表示，近月勞工市場大致平穩。本地經濟持續擴張、消費氣氛穩健，加上訪港旅遊業繼續增長，應會為整體勞工市場提供支持。政府會密切留意外圍環境不確定因素，並為求職者提供適切支援。
